name: Kuboya Miharu
source:
“Can you promise me? If anything happens, don’t listen to what anyone says but me.”

An orphan raised in a facility run by the church next to the school grounds, which makes him unusual for a student at such a prestigious school. He’s a mood-maker who is kind and cheerful to everyone, but at the same time he takes extreme consideration for those around him. For some reason, he has a tendency to get extremely neurotic whenever it concerns his long involvement with his guardian or the stress of dealing with his homeroom teacher. He’s skilled with his hands, and has a good memory. He’s part of the church choir.
He’s cocky towards Izumi, but is weak to Kaya.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
